title: Welcome to your studio
text: Welcome to Voice Studio. Let's take a quick look around. You can record your voice, create new dialogue, clean up audio, and bring it all together in a mix. The demo clips are there to explore whenever you're ready.

title: 2. Record and prepare audio
text: The Audio library is on the left. Record microphone captures your voice, or Import audio brings in a file. Select a clip to see its waveform. Use Play to listen, and drag the handles or enter In and Out times to trim.

title: 3. Create a voice and generate dialogue
text: Voice cloning is where recordings become reusable voices. Choose a clean reference, enter exactly what it says, name it, and save the voice profile. Select that profile, write something new in Dialogue, and press Generate speech. You can play, compare, and download the result.

title: 4. Clean, arrange, export, and save
text: Cleanup gives you noise reduction, normalization, a high pass filter, and fades. Applying an edit creates a new version, so your original stays safe. Add clips to the timeline, drag them into place, and adjust each track's volume or mute. Play mix lets you listen. Export mixed WAV saves the audio. Save session keeps your arrangement for later. And in the shared demo, invited guests share the files in that workspace.
